draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.30, the 59th-best grade among 257 2025 draftees and 8th of 31 at WR. He went 55th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Alec Pierce. Testing concerns: 40-yard dash (19th percentile). College production: 1,030 receiving yards in 2024, 8th of 31 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 2 pro, currently with the Los Angeles Chargers. 17 career games and 10 starts over 1 completed season, plus 4 so far in 2026. Still developing: 3 AV in 2025. Strengths in 2025: catch rate 69.8% (83rd percentile), drop rate 2.3% (81st percentile). Versus the typical Year-1 wide receiver who played: 324 receiving yards against a median of 198, above the norm.
